aboutLead: We are a full-stack development team focused on building modern, responsive, and user-friendly web applications. From React and Vite on the front end to Express and MongoDB on the backend, we build complete solutions with secure JWT-based authentication tying everything together. We don't just write code; we plan the data model, build the API, craft the interface, and deliver products that are built to perform in production. Our goal on every project is simple: fewer surprises for you, a product that's easy to maintain, and an experience your users will genuinely enjoy.
